name: ssvep_spectral
note: Does the encoder's SPECTRAL branch close the SSVEP deficit? The trunk is 18.9 points behind ATCNet and EEGNet on SSVEP -- its worst result anywhere -- and the mechanism account says why: multi-scale dilated convolution is a prior for transient structure at several timescales, and SSVEP is stationary narrowband entrainment where every timepoint carries identical information. The encoder already contains a per-channel STFT branch built for exactly that signal class, and it is DISABLED in every arm reported so far. n_fft matters and is not a free parameter: the 12 stimulation frequencies are spaced 0.5 Hz apart (9.25-14.75 Hz), so at 250 Hz an n_fft of 256 gives 0.98 Hz resolution and CANNOT separate adjacent classes, while 512 gives 0.49 Hz and can. Including the 256 arm makes that a measurement rather than an assertion. This is the test the mechanism account predicts: if the deficit is the wrong temporal prior, supplying an explicit frequency view should close much of it; if it does not, the account is incomplete and the deficit stands as reported.
